description.value: Richlea Bakery is a family-run scratch bakery in Ladner (Delta), BC offering a wide range of sweets and savoury pastries, including Cronuts, butter tarts, fruit pies, sausage rolls, cornish pasties, and steak-and-onion pies. Custom cakes, cupcakes, and a selection of gluten-friendly options are also available. Coffee is served in-store, making it a potentially welcome treat stop for touring cyclists passing through the Delta area.
